payload.goalOutcome:
Build "Service Request Tracker — Production Acceptance v0.2": a Node.js CLI app.

Capabilities (each MUST be implemented and verified):
1. Create: "node src/index.js create \"<title>\" \"<description>\"" writes a new request with status="open" and a generated id, then prints the id to stdout.
2. List: "node src/index.js list" prints all requests as a JSON array to stdout.
3. Update: "node src/index.js update <id> <new-status>" transitions status; valid forward transitions: open→in_progress, in_progress→resolved only. Reject same-status, backward, and unknown statuses.
4. Persist: store all requests in "data/requests.json" (create dir + file if absent).
5. Reject invalid inputs: empty title, unknown id, unknown new-status, invalid transition — each prints a clear error to stderr and exits code 1.
6. Automated tests using node:test (built-in): at least 6 cases covering (a) create, (b) list, (c) update, (d) persistence across restart, (e) invalid-input rejection, (f) one negative test.
7. README.md with: app description, install, run tests, CLI usage examples (create/list/update), valid status transitions table.

After producing all 5 files, finish with artifacts: ["package.json","README.md","src/index.js","src/store.js","test/app.test.js"].

After producing all files, npm test MUST exit 0 within 60 seconds.

payload.rationale: Scope "complex" in domain "software-engineering" with 4 capability needs. Planned 4 specialist role(s): Software Engineer [code-execution], Documentation Writer [document-authoring], Generalist Worker [data-analysis], Verification Engineer [browser-verification]. Mission Coordinator added because 3+ specialists require integration.
